## Who

Naiemul Hasan Naiem (Naiem) is a QA Engineer at Tulip Tech, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh (UTC+6). CS Engineering graduate from AIUB (Aug 2018 — Jan 2024). Career transition from network support (Race Online, Jun 2024 — Nov 2025) into QA (Tulip Tech, Dec 2025 — present).

## Core expertise

- Manual testing: structured 10-layer test-case design, exploratory, regression, bug filing/retest
- Test automation: Playwright + TypeScript (primary), Maestro (mobile YAML)
- Architecture: 4-Tier POM (locators / pages / utils / tests) — zero raw selectors in spec files
- API testing: Playwright request, Postman
- Mobile testing: Maestro YAML flows
- Test management: TestRail (Suite-based)
- Figma / design QA: design-to-build comparison, spec-vs-build discrepancy flagging
- Security testing: RBAC, OAuth, auth boundary, multi-tenant isolation
- Domain: fintech (FCA/KYC/AML) and healthcare-adjacent (payment/booking integrity)
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Allure reporting
- AI-driven workflow: requirement harvesting, test plan/case generation, failure triage, risk prediction
